projects.title: Late Night Feels
connection_reasons: Four lyrics circle the same breakup from different distances: the sweater, the toothbrush, the replayed conversations, the sinking.
'broken heart' and 'illusion' are both in A at 117.5 BPM, which makes them same-song candidates and not only thematic neighbours.
'lake bottoms' (A minor, 136 BPM) shares the tonic and reads as the low point of the same story.

next_action.action: Start from the shared ground: 'broken heart' and 'illusion' are both in A at 117.5 BPM. Sing the 'illusion' chorus over the 'broken heart' verse bed at that tempo, then try the 'Wanna' lines as a second verse, transposed from D minor.

projects.title: Bounce Session
connection_reasons: Three pieces built on groove first and words second, all with a playful, confident attitude.
'somewhat bouncy bass' (129.2 BPM) and 'damn right' (136 BPM) sit within a small tempo stretch of each other.

next_action.action: Set the session to 129 BPM around the 'somewhat bouncy bass' loop and deliver the 'damn right' verse over it; 136 down to 129 is a small stretch. Keep 'Funkyy' (95.7 BPM) aside as a slower breakdown idea.

projects.title: Golden Hour
connection_reasons: Unhurried, warm material: a sunrise drive, a night of doing nothing, and an instrumental bed that fits under both.
'Chilling' at 68 BPM is exact half-time against 'delight ft ultradiolet' at 136 BPM, and 'laid back beat' shares A minor with 'delight'.

next_action.action: 'Chilling' at 68 BPM is exact half-time against 'delight' at 136. Loop the 'Chilling' bed under the 'delight' verse and sing the road-trip lines in a half-time feel. Check G major against A minor by ear before committing.
